usage.notice: Complete usage is tied to an accepted substantive final by public turn identity/order. Other available counters stay partial. Reasoning/cache are subsets, never extra totals. Missing usage, native HTTP counts and unclosed turns remain unknown; analysis is never gated.

public_observations.timing_scope: Host observation intervals at existing process polls, not provider token times; local scheduling and monitoring can widen intervals beyond 30 seconds

network.scope: Timestamped and line-indexed diagnostic signals only. Public reconnect notices may repeat stderr; auxiliary endpoints, provider HTTP requests and native process launches are distinct.

scope: Saved public evidence only, with possible live observation races. Native request time includes local, connection and response time; pure generation and unreported provider usage are unavailable. Counts describe inspected receipts, not permissions, and exclude the inherited calls from fresh totals.
